summary: TAL Education Group filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year ended February 28, 2026. The filing reports net revenues of $802.4 million for Q4 FY2026 and $3,008.9 million for the full year, with net income attributable to TAL of $244.8 million and $530.8 million, respectively. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender offer, spin-off, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring) is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation filing.
